draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
rationale: The claim asserts Wrenfold's advantage may extend to unseen customer-service domains, but the evaluation only covered Banking and Travel, the same domains used for training. No unseen-domain evaluation was performed, so the claim has no support.
